prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Looksy assistant character redesign concept. The user liked the tangible CGI rendering quality of an earlier proposal but rejected its camera-eyed optical-robot character design. Design a substantially different original character. Aim for the sophistication of a theatrical animated feature: appealing sculptural silhouette, believable dimensional anatomy, expressive acting, carefully groomed or authored surfaces, physically based material response, rich but controlled lighting, convincing contact shadows and weight. Full-body beauty render, one character only, three-quarter front view, square composition, entire silhouette and feet visible with safe margins, almost fills image. Seamless dark charcoal studio floor/backdrop. Large soft warm key, cool gentle fill, narrow soft rim. Character in sharp focus, natural portrait lens perspective. No text, logos, labels, panel borders, props, cameras, monitor faces, screen eyes, lens eyes, neon glow, scanlines, flat vector shading, outlines or recognizable existing movie characters. Personality should feel intelligent, observant, quietly funny, with an independent spark rather than babyish cuteness or a bland stock mascot.
Direction B — sculpted otherworldly companion. An original small nonhuman organic creature, no fur, no machinery. A broad softly wedge-shaped head flows into a compact sturdy body with a slight forward lean. Two short thick supple swept-back ear fins emerge low on the head and curl inward at the tips, making a distinctive broken-arch silhouette, never giant rabbit ears. A tiny broad upturned snout, generous expressive cheek and brow forms, two naturally proportioned deep brown/amber eyes with slightly hooded eyelids, and a subtle crooked mouth able to convey dry humor and concentration. Short substantial arms, elegant three-fingered hands, two strong short legs and big soft padded feet, one short broad paddle-shaped tail. Skin is tactile warm mushroom-gray, velvety matte with subtle subsurface light transmission at ears and fingers, fine almost invisible pores and sculpted skin folds at moving joints, a slightly paler cream underside. Subtle cool slate coloration along crown and outer ear fins. It looks like a living sculpted creature with real musculature and soft weight, not a plastic toy, robot, alien in a costume or flat shape. Attentive weight-shifted stance, one hand resting lightly against its own chin and the other relaxed, a gently skeptical yet warm expression. Strong authored character acting and unusual proportions. No blue skin, no huge kawaii eyes, no cloning an established alien character.
